create_frozen_batch_norm_2d: create a FrozenBatchNorm2d layer with fixed statistics for inference on pretrained backbone models
convert_module_to_frozen_batchnorm: convert all BatchNorm and SyncBatchNorm layers in a module to FrozenBatchNorm2d for inference
convert_frozen_to_batchnorm: convert FrozenBatchNorm2d layers back to BatchNorm2d for quantization compatibility
get_norm_layer_by_name: get a normalization layer instance by string name such as BN, SyncBN, FrozenBN, GN, or LN
create_naive_sync_batch_norm: create a NaiveSyncBatchNorm layer that correctly handles gradient computation across workers with different batch sizes
